add_typelib(mshtml_tlb.idl)

list(APPEND mshtml_tlb_rc_deps
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mshtml_tlb.tlb
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mshtml_tlb.rgs)

# mshtml.tlb is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mshtml_tlb-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
add_cargo_module(mshtml.tlb mshtml_tlb-cargo mshtml.tlb
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mshtml_tlb.tlb)
add_dependencies(mshtml.tlb_cargo stdole2 xdk)
